entries.title: Matthew 1:1
segments: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

entries.title: Matthew 1:2
segments: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judah and his brethren;

entries.title: Matthew 1:3
segments: and Judah begat Perez and Zerah of Tamar; and Perez begat Hezron; and Hezron begat Ram;

entries.title: Matthew 1:4
segments: and Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon; and Nahshon begat Salmon;

entries.title: Matthew 1:5
segments: and Salmon begat Boaz of Rahab; and Boaz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

entries.title: Matthew 1:6
segments: and Jesse begat David the king. And David begat Solomon of her [that had been the wife] of Uriah;

entries.title: Matthew 1:7
segments: and Solomon begat Rehoboam; and Rehoboam begat Abijah; and Abijah begat Asa;

entries.title: Matthew 1:8
segments: and Asa begat Jehoshaphat; and Jehoshaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Uzziah;

entries.title: Matthew 1:9
segments: and Uzziah begat Jotham; and Jotham begat Ahaz; and Ahaz begat Hezekiah;

entries.title: Matthew 1:10
segments: and Hezekiah begat Manasseh; and Manasseh begat Amon; and Amon begat Josiah;

entries.title: Matthew 1:11
segments: and Josiah begat Jechoniah and his brethren, at the time of the carrying away to Babylon.

entries.title: Matthew 1:12
segments: And after the carrying away to Babylon, Jechoniah begat Shealtiel; and Shealtiel begat Zerubbabel;

entries.title: Matthew 1:13
segments: and Zerubbabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

entries.title: Matthew 1:14
segments: and Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

entries.title: Matthew 1:15
segments: and Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

entries.title: Matthew 1:16
segments: and Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

entries.title: Matthew 1:17
segments: So all the generations from Abraham unto David are fourteen generations; and from David unto the carrying away to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon unto the Christ fourteen generations.

entries.title: Matthew 1:18
segments: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found with child of the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Matthew 1:19
segments: And Joseph her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.

entries.title: Matthew 1:20
segments: But when he thought on these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Matthew 1:21
segments: And she shall bring forth a son; and thou shalt call his name JESUS; for it is he that shall save his people from their sins.

entries.title: Matthew 1:22
segments: Now all this is come to pass, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

entries.title: Matthew 1:23
segments: Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, And they shall call his name Immanuel; which is, being interpreted, God with us.

entries.title: Matthew 1:24
segments: And Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took unto him his wife;

entries.title: Matthew 1:25
segments: and knew her not till she had brought forth a son: and he called his name JESUS.
